Subject: Onboarding request — Cascadia Labs (legal name, tax forms, PO contact)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the onboarding link. We're ready to be added to Redwood's vendor registry so we can start receiving POs for the pilot integration. Attached are the documents I have on hand: a completed W-9, our Certificate of Good Standing, and a CSV with our AP contact and bank remit instructions.

Quick confirmations we need from your side so we can map POs to the right inbox:
- Legal entity name to be recorded (should match W-9): Cascadia Labs, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Default invoice recipient: billing@cascadialabs.io
- Preferred PO contact: procurement@cascadialabs.io (this is monitored by our procurement team)
- Payment terms requested: Net30

If there are additional fields required for Redwood's ERP (tax jurisdiction, vendor classification, buy-supplier code), let me know and I can provide them. We would like the PO flow verified this week if possible — the pilot team is planning to issue a test PO on Friday.

Best,
Emma Choi
Procurement Lead
Cascadia Labs
emma.choi@cascadialabs.io
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: 2027-04-03T16:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding request — Cascadia Labs (legal name, tax forms, PO contact)

Emma — thanks for sending these. I opened the thread into our vendor intake queue and copied Ben from AP so we can assign a PO gatekeeper and verify banking details.

Immediate checklist for vendor master creation (items we will capture and what we need from you if anything is missing):
- Legal name (exact): Cascadia Labs, Inc. (please confirm this is the legal name on the W-9)
- EIN / Tax ID: 12-3456789 (confirm)
- Entity type: C-Corp / US domestic (if different, flag)
- Registered address: please confirm the address you want in our master file (street, city, state, zip)
- Invoice email: billing@cascadialabs.io (we will set this as default route)
- PO contact & PO acknowledgement email: procurement@cascadialabs.io (we can also add a PO-focused alias if you prefer)
- Banking instructions: Ben will validate the CSV with our payment team; we may request a voided check or bank letter if the net amount exceeds threshold on first payment
- Payment terms: Net30 requested — we will set Net30 in the vendor record unless Finance requests a different default. Early payment discounts can be handled via our AP portal (Ben will advise).

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Ben will create the vendor record and assign vendor code (I will confirm vendor code in this thread).
2) Finance will validate bank details and set remit instructions (Ben — can you take point?)
3) Procurement/ops will run a PO test to confirm routing and acknowledgement.

Can you also confirm who is authorized to sign purchase orders on Cascadia's side (name and title)? That helps us set PO approver metadata.

I'll aim to have vendor code and a PO-routing test scheduled by Friday if banking validation is fast.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
